A person holds a dark smartphone and places its rear camera/flash area directly over the black ink dot. The woman covers her mouth with her hand while laughing and speaking, showing high energy. She looks genuinely concerned or fearful as the phone is brought toward her arm. The smartphone flash illuminates briefly. She suddenly screams, recoiling her arm and jumping back while pointing at the black dot, eventually breaking into laughter along with the group. The background remains consistent with office furniture, white walls, and various electronic items.
